text:
Sam: Heads-up team — planning the "Inference Insights" newsletter invite + live walkthrough. Target send Thu 9AM PT for NA/EU, staggered 9AM SGT for APAC. Need final subject, RSVP gating, routing rules, and suppression list.
Ivy: Primary cohorts: trial-30d, newsletter-active (opened 30d), docs-downloaders. Docs-downloaders = high-intent bucket; exclude from subject test.
Noah: RSVP form fields: name, email, company, role, company_size, intent (benchmark/cost/ops), want_demo boolean. Hidden UTMs: utm_campaign=inference_insights_apr, source=email, cohort={cohort}.
Tara: Subject test ideas: A) "Inference Insights: benchmark + live ops" B) "See how teams cut inference cost — live". For trials test emoji vs none; docs-downloaders get a personalized company line.
Luis: Routing pseudo-rule: if (role =~ /(Head|Director|CTO|PM|ML)/ || company_size >= 500) -> sdr-enterprise; else if (cohort == "trial") -> sdr-trial; else -> sdr-nurture. For docs-downloaders with previous demo interest -> sdr-enterprise-high.
Ivy: Suppress: attended or RSVP'd last 60d, unsubscribed, bounced. Also dedupe across cohorts with highest-intent priority.
Noah: Confirmation flow: RSVP -> confirmation page with calendar add + conditional "Book a demo" button when owner == sdr-enterprise. Pass lead_score=high for docs-downloaders.
Tara: Preheader options: "Thu 9AM PT  25min demo + live Q&A" or "Latency, cost, and ops tradeoffs — live". Keep under 80 chars.
forms-bot: Note: webhook deploy scheduled Wed 19:00 PT to wire form -> CRM staging. Please validate mapping of utm, cohort, role, and lead_score.
Luis: I'll export segments and drop CSV to /marketing/seg-exports/inference-insights by EOD and mark APAC timezone recipients.
Sam: Owners: Noah (RSVP form + hidden UTMs), Ivy (segmentation + suppressions), Tara (copy + subject tests), Luis (segment export + APAC staging), forms-bot (deploy webhook). We do 15m pre-send check Wed 3PM PT.
Tara: I'll drop copy and 3 subject variants into #copy-review in 90m.
Sam: Thanks — include a short RSVP survey question: "primary reason for attending" (benchmark, cost, ops) so follow-up cadence can be targeted.
